name: UMO+ DXU
pre_gcode: M104 S{temp}       ; p3d: need to heat the nozzle
M109 S{temp}       ; p3d: wait for nozzle temperature
"; Script based on an original created by tjjfvi (https://github.com/tjjfvi)
; An up-to-date version of the tjjfvi's original script can be found
; Note - This script will only work in Cura V4.2 and above!
M355 S1 P25;turn on case light
; PLEASE CHECK: M200 D0 T{initial_extruder_nr} ;reset filament diameter
; PLEASE CHECK: T{initial_extruder_nr} ;switch to the first nozzle used for print
; PLEASE CHECK: M104 T{initial_extruder_nr} S{material_standby_temperature, initial_extruder_nr}
G0 X25 Y20 F7200 ;change Y20 to Y0 ansonl
; PLEASE CHECK: M109 T{initial_extruder_nr} S{material_print_temperature_layer_0, initial_extruder_nr}
G1 E0 F200 ;purge nozzle ;change F45 to F200 like ultimaker code ansonl
G1 Y50 F9000 ;add quick movement to Y50 like ultimaker code ansonl
M355 S1 P50;turn on case light"
post_gcode: G0 F15000 X8.0 Y8.0 Z3.5 E-4.5 ;Wiping+material retraction ;increase bed lower 0.5>5.0 and add Y movement
G0 F10000 Z1.5 E4.5 ;Compensation for the retraction
T0 ; move to the first head
